notes.title: New game mode
notes.content: [p][b]What's New[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New game mode[/b] with 15 levels for solo players — the more stars, the better! Fewer deaths and faster times will earn you higher scores.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat mode improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Victory system added: win by reaching 7 kills[/p][/*][*][p]Improved animation when a player is eliminated[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]And various UI improvements![/p][/*][/list]
